absence_here_depends_shipped_wordlist_be: Absence here depends on the shipped wordlist being correct. Its SHA-256 is
binary_size_inline_viewer_type_inside_ar: {Binary}, {size}. No inline viewer for this type inside an archive — export the archive to work with it.
both_record_programs_machine_knew_about_: Both record programs the machine knew about. ShimCache proves a file was examined, not necessarily run; Amcache adds the SHA-1, which identifies the binary even after it is deleted.
browser_would_write_clipboard_own_usuall: The browser would not write to the clipboard on its own — that usually needs a real key press or click behind it. The value is below and already selected: press Ctrl+C, or ⌘C.
bytes_after_end_file_inside_final_cluste: Bytes after end-of-file inside the final cluster. Often holds fragments of whatever occupied the cluster before.
carve.estimated_notice: This file does not say how long it is and nothing exact ended it, so its end is an estimate. Treat the tail as unverified.
carve.pattern_syntax: Hex bytes such as FF D8, ?? for any one byte, and ASCII text in double quotes such as "PK".
carve.signature_intro: A file type of your own, found by the bytes it starts with. Kept with your preferences on this computer, not in the case; every carve writes the signatures it used into the case's audit log.
case.case_file_records_evidence_bookmark:
A case file records its evidence, bookmarks and audit
      trail. Opening one reopens the image it was built against.
cases.no_evidence: This case has no evidence in it yet.
cases.no_recent: No cases opened from this machine yet, under this name.
cases.none_open: No case is open. Start one, or open a case you have worked on before.
cases.only_this: The case that is open is the only one you have opened from this machine under this name.
catalogue_built_subset_version_technique: Catalogue: built-in subset ({version}) — the techniques a disk image can evidence, not the whole matrix. Import MITRE's own catalogue from the ATT&CK tab for the rest.
click_did_land_byte_right_click_values: That click did not land on a byte. Right-click one of the values, or drag across a range first.
closecase.intro: Nothing is lost. Everything recorded in this case is already written to the case file, which stays where it is — this puts it down and releases the evidence files so they can be copied or hashed.
compare_bip_39_s_english_txt_before: — compare it with BIP-39's english.txt before relying on this being empty.
compressed_prefetch_decoded_using_operat: Compressed prefetch was decoded using the operating system’s decompressor. A portable implementation is pending, so this artefact is currently Windows-only.
dates_show_local_time_utc_click_change: Dates show local time and UTC. Click to change.
dates_show_utc_click_apply_local_offset: Dates show UTC. Click to apply a local offset.
deriving_key_entered_format_specifies_ab: Deriving the key from what you entered. The format specifies about a million rounds of hashing — that delay is deliberate, and it is what stops a short password being guessed quickly.
every_partition_plus_unallocated_space_g: Every partition, plus unallocated space and gaps. Runs in the task tray — you can close this.
exhibit_removed_case_evidence_file_itsel: {exhibit} was removed from the case. The evidence file itself is untouched.
ext_size_decoded_browser_play_codec_insi: {ext} · {size}. Decoded by the browser. If it does not play, the codec inside this container is one the browser cannot decode — the bytes are intact; export and open it elsewhere.
fat_exfat_volumes_record_local_time_alre: FAT and exFAT volumes record local time already — an offset is not applied to their timestamps, because doing so would shift them twice.
filelist.select_partition_folder_list_co: Select a partition or folder to list its contents.
finding_every_browser_database_volume_sc: Finding every browser database on the volume by its schema rather than its filename, joining visits to URLs, and recovering deleted rows from free space.
folders_opened_explorer_reconstructed_ba: Folders opened in Explorer, reconstructed from BagMRU shell items. These survive the folder being deleted or the drive being removed.
hash_recorded_before_tool_stored_how_muc: This hash was recorded before the tool stored how much of the file it read, so whether it covers the whole file is not known from the case. Rehashing settles it.
inspect.no_bytes_here: No bytes here: this is a collection of files. Select one to see its own bytes.
inspect.select_partition_file_carved_ite:
Select a partition, file, or carved item to see where it
        lives on the media.
journal_journal_id_cap_max_size_lowest: Journal {journal_id} · cap {max_size} · lowest valid USN {lowest_valid_usn}. A different journal id means the journal was deleted and recreated, and USNs restart.
key_held_session_only_never_written_case: The key is held for this session only and is never written to the case file. The unlock itself is recorded; the secret is not.
keys.unmodified_keys_ignored_while_text_:
Unmodified keys are ignored while a text field has
      focus, so none of these fire mid-search.
local_storage_session_storage_indexeddb_: Local Storage, Session Storage, IndexedDB and Sync Data, including the write-ahead logs where the most recent writes live.
lzxpress_decompressor_host_compressed_pr: No LZXPRESS decompressor on this host, so compressed prefetch files were not read. A portable implementation is pending.
machine_identity_usb_storage_attached_ne: Machine identity, USB storage attached, networks joined, auto-start programs, installed software, local accounts and user activity. Finding the hives means walking the filesystem first, which is the slow part.

stores_found_no_messages.one: {count} mail store found ({kinds}), but no messages could be read from it.
stores_found_no_messages.other: {count} mail stores found ({kinds}), but no messages could be read from them.

mail_attachment_no_inline_viewer: {content_type}, {size}. No inline viewer for this type.
mail_stores_identified_content_rather_ex: Mail stores are identified by content rather than by extension — .msg on a Windows volume is more often a resource file than a message.
mark.working_marks_used_navigate_do_not:
Working marks used to navigate do not belong in a report.
      Marks left out are still kept in the case and the audit log, and the
      report says how many were held back.

none_match_filter.one: No marks match that filter. {count} mark in the case.
none_match_filter.other: No marks match that filter. {count} marks in the case.

marks_yet_select_bytes_hex_view_press: No marks yet. Select bytes in the hex view and press Mark to record where you found something.
matches_terms_indexed_documents_indexed_: No matches for {terms} in {indexed_documents} indexed documents.
matches_windows_stores_most_text_utf_16l: No matches. Windows stores most text as UTF-16LE — make sure that encoding is ticked.
md5_sha_1_sha_256_single_pass: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and a fuzzy hash in a single pass per file. MD5 and SHA-1 because published hash sets are keyed on them; SHA-256 because that is what anyone verifying an export will expect; the fuzzy hash to surface files that are alike rather than identical.
name_survives_only_change_journal_file_o: "{name}" survives only in the change journal — {there}. There is no file to open; the record is the finding.
newcase.intro: A case can exist before any evidence is in it. Nothing is written to it until you add an exhibit, and the file will not be created over anything already there.
newcase.pick_folder: Choose the folder the case file should go in.
nobody_recorded_examining_case_yet: . Nobody is recorded as examining this case yet.
nothing_active_found_still_rendered_sani: Nothing active was found in this {what}. It is still rendered from a sanitised copy inside a sandbox.
nothing_attributed_yet_tag_file_mark_giv: Nothing attributed yet. Tag a file or a mark and give it a technique.
nothing_been_recorded_against_exhibit_ye: Nothing has been recorded against this exhibit yet, so nothing else is lost with it.
nothing_found_these_settings_try_turning: Nothing found with these settings. Try turning off cluster alignment, or widen the scope.
nothing_image_states_time_zone_set_hand: Nothing in this image states a time zone. Set one by hand if the case supports it.
nothing_shown_below_because_nothing_retu: Nothing is shown below because nothing was returned — an empty panel here would look like a file with no properties.
nothing_tagged_yet_select_file_use_tag: Nothing tagged yet. Select a file and use Tag… in the inspector.
only_read_bytes_claimed_size_could_read: Only {read_bytes} of {claimed_size} could be read, so these are digests of what was recoverable — not of the file. They will not match a hash set, and they should not be quoted as the file's hashes.
open.kind_file: A single file, or a zip opened as the collection inside it. Nothing is carved and nothing is marked deleted: these are files that were handed over, not a copy of media.
open.kind_folder: A folder and everything below it. There is no image to hash — each file is hashed on its own — and no unallocated space or slack.
open.point_strata_at_e01_ex01_raw:
Point Strata at an E01, Ex01, raw, VHDX or VMDK image.
      The file is opened read-only and never written to.
palette.move_enter_run_esc_close: ↑↓ to move · Enter to run · Esc to close
picker.everything_here_runs_background_c:
Everything here runs in the background, cheapest first, so
      the fast answers arrive while a long one is still going. Each one
      appears in the task tray with its progress and can be cancelled on its
      own — nothing you start here commits you to waiting for it.
preview.select_file_preview: Select a file to preview it.
ran_how_often_files_each_program_opened: What ran, when, how often, and which files each program opened at startup — often the only surviving record of a deleted executable and its data.
readable_content_clusters_may_unallocate: No readable content — the clusters may be unallocated or overwritten.
readable_shortcuts_seen_entries_seen_emp: No readable shortcuts ({seen} entries seen, {empty} of them empty).
reading_each_allocated_file_turn_deleted: Reading each allocated file in turn, deleted entries included. This walks the filesystem rather than the raw media, so every hit carries the file it came from.
reading_first_few_hundred_bytes_every_fi: Reading the first few hundred bytes of every file and comparing what it holds against what its name claims. A mismatch is only reported where the extension names a definite format and the content is a definite, different one — otherwise nearly every file on a disk would be flagged and the report would be useless.
record_stream_named_here_may_been_rename: This record has no stream named {here}. It may have been renamed or stripped since the name was recorded.
recovered_free_cells_windows_marks_delet: Recovered from free cells. Windows marks a deleted key or value free without scrubbing it, so the name, type and often the data survive until the space is reused. Nothing here is still linked into the tree — treat the parentage as unknown.
recovered_free_space_freeblock_deleted_c: Recovered from free space — {freeblock} from deleted cells, {unallocated} from unallocated page space, {freelist} from free pages. These have no rowid and their columns are inferred, so treat the layout as unknown.
remove.cannot_undone_audit_log_keeps_rec:
This cannot be undone. The audit log keeps a record of the
      removal and of what was deleted with it.
remove.evidence_file_disk_never_touched_:
The evidence file on disk is never touched. What is
      deleted is this exhibit's place in the case and the work recorded
      against it.
report_written_path_r_open_browser_print: Report written to {path} ({r}). Open it in a browser and print to PDF if you need one.
restored_case_phrase_text_never_stored_o: Restored from the case. Phrase text is never stored, so the offsets below are recorded but the words are not — re-run against the image to recover them.
resyncs_point_s_journal_could_followed_s: {resyncs} point(s) in the journal could not be followed and were skipped ({resync_bytes} bytes). The records either side are sound; the gap is reported rather than closed over.
seed_phrase_results_run_cannot_relied_up: ). Seed phrase results from this run cannot be relied upon.
seed_phrases_confirmed_against_their_own: Seed phrases are confirmed against their own checksum rather than matched by shape, so a run of twelve ordinary words is not reported as a wallet. Anything recovered stays in this session and is not written to the case.
selection_value_copying_limited_copy_max: That selection is {value}; copying is limited to {COPY_MAX}. Export it instead — the whole range is written out and hashed.
settings.messages: The status line at the bottom reports what the application is doing. Turn off the kinds you do not want to see.
settings.problems_always: Problems and refusals are always shown. A refusal nobody sees is an examination that quietly did less than you think it did.
settings.times: Local time is only shown once a timezone has been applied to the case, and always carries the zone it was worked out in. The report cites UTC whichever you choose here.
settings.where_kept: These are yours, not the case's. They are kept beside the application under your examiner name, so a case never changes because of how you like to read it.
sparse_skipped_stream_unallocated_window: {sparse_skipped} of the stream is unallocated — Windows purges the head of the journal by releasing clusters, not by rewriting them. Those records are gone, and that is a limit of the evidence rather than of the reading of it.
strata_reads_directory_tree_file_name_pa: Strata reads the directory tree from $FILE_NAME parent references rather than from the directory indexes, so deleted and orphaned records stay visible. That means one pass over every record on the volume before the first listing. It is done once per volume — later directories open immediately.
stream_present_record_holds_bytes_empty_: This stream is present on the record but holds no bytes. An empty stream is still a fact about the file — something created it.
techniques_techniques_imported_attributi: {techniques} techniques imported. Attributions already made are unchanged.
these_reported_because_evidence_about_fi: These are reported because they are evidence about the file. The rendering below is of the cleaned copy; the bytes on the media are untouched.
timeline.from_tag: This item could not be found again on its volume, so these events come from what was recorded when it was tagged: three timestamps at most, and no position on the media.
tree.duplicates_across_evidence_items: Files whose digest matches across evidence items — only among files an examiner has already hashed, since nothing here hashes a file just to compare it.
tree.similar_across_evidence_items: Files whose fuzzy hash is alike, across evidence items — a partial match, not an exact one, so it can surface edited or partially-overwritten copies that share no digest. Only among files an examiner has already hashed.
tree.every_file_chosen_volume_md5_sha:
Every file on the chosen volume, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and a fuzzy hash
          in one pass each. Hash a single file or folder by right-clicking it
          in the tree or the listing.
tz.every_timestamp_stored_utc_stays_way:
Every timestamp is stored in UTC and stays that way. An
      offset changes only what is shown beside it — nothing recorded is
      altered, and the choice is written to the audit log.
unpartitioned_space_holds_files_hash_car: Unpartitioned space holds no files to hash. Carve it instead.
usnjrnl_records_happened_files_rather_cr: $UsnJrnl records what happened to files rather than what they are — creations, renames, moves and deletions — and the entries outlive the MFT records they describe.
utc_cannot_converted_without_knowing_whe: — they are not UTC and cannot be converted without knowing where the archive was written.
volume_encrypted_unlock_list_contents: This volume is encrypted. Unlock it to list its contents.

idle_browsers.one: {count} other browser connected without a name or an open case.
idle_browsers.other: {count} other browsers connected without a name or an open case.

who.attribution: This is what the audit log records against everything you do. It is stated, and not verified — the server does not authenticate anyone, and this name is an attribution, not proof of who performed an action. Changing it mid-session is recorded as its own entry; earlier work keeps the name it was done under.
why_bytes_intact_shown_below_export_writ: {why} The bytes are intact and shown below; Export writes the file out for an external tool.
